faq.q: Do I need to log into Instagram?
faq.a: Public content needs no login; just paste the link. Private account material is restricted, and even with cookies you should confirm you have permission.

faq.q: Why did pasting the link do nothing?
faq.a: Instagram links often carry tracking parameters such as igsh. They are usually tolerated — if it fails, copy a clean URL from the browser.
The image set is detected automatically and every picture is saved, not just the cover.

faq.q: Can I save the audio too?
faq.a: Yes. Switch to MP3 audio mode before downloading to export the music or voice as an audio file.
